name: zauq-frames
description: Zauq Frames - custom photo frames storefront (React + Vite client, Node + Express API).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,admin -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w admin
